body: BenDaDonn was TASED and detained by police officers in Texas Popular streamer and content creator BenDaDonnn was tased and arrested by police in Texas following the Texas A&M football game. Video footage capturing the incident spread rapidly online, showing officers deploying a Taser during a tense confrontation before placing BenDaDonnn and members of his security detail in handcuffs as an onlooker crowd gathered around. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

source_caption_text:
BenDaDonn was TASED and detained by police officers in Texas 😳👮

Popular streamer and content creator BenDaDonnn was tased and arrested by police in Texas following the Texas A&M football game. Video footage capturing the incident spread rapidly online, showing officers deploying a Taser during a tense confrontation before placing BenDaDonnn and members of his security detail in handcuffs as an onlooker crowd gathered around. According to initial reports, he was subsequently booked on charges including evading arrest or detention. Local authorities have not yet released a full official statement detailing every factor that precipitated the physical escalation.
